items.content_text: Founder and CEO Jesper Kouthoofd revealed the plans in an interview with Highsnobiety.

items.title: The Skinny to return after Scottish arts charity steps in
items.content_text: The Scottish cultural magazine announced its closure earlier this month after publisher Radge Media CIC ceased operations.

items.title: Melbourne Instruments launches free library of Roto-Control setups
items.content_text: The Melbourne Exchange features more than 60 user-made setups for plugins, pedals and synths, alongside software built using Roto-Control's published APIs.

items.title: Prague's Music Club Pulse 22 to close next month
items.content_text: The techno-focused venue will host its final parties on November 27th through 29th.

items.title: Streaming service bot farmer sentenced to prison in criminal streaming fraud case in US
items.content_text: 54-year-old Michael Smith will serve 18 months in prison and forfeit $8 million earned royalties.

items.title: New York promoter Teksupport and parent firm ordered to cease operations
items.content_text: Following months of legal disputes, a court ruled the long-running party series to stop after November 7th.

items.title: Roland maps electronic music's past and future across ADE 2026
items.content_text: The legacy musical instrument maker will support a series of events exploring electronic music's relationship with technology, deep listening, environmental sound and Detroit techno.

items.title: New listening bar to open in London's Barbican Centre
items.content_text: Spiritland is launching the 100-capacity venue on October 20th.
